```{r}
#| label: 06-01-read

library(tidyverse)

read_lines("simon-5507-06-demo1.sas") |>
  paste0(collapse="\n") |>
  str_split(pattern="\n\n") |>
  unlist() -> code_chunks
```

```{r}
#| label: display-chunks
#| asis: true

for (i in 1:length(code_chunks)) {
  cat("\n\n## Code chunk ")
  cat(i)
  cat("\n\n")
  cat(code_chunk[i])
}
```
